title: Protein electroporation of Cre recombinase into cultured _Arabidopsis_ cells with an intact cell wall
protocol: Mix 1 ng of plasmid pET-HNCre(A207T) and 20 μL of E. coli strain BL21(DE3) competent cells in a 1.5 mL-tube.
Incubate the competent cell/DNA mixture on ice for 5 min.
Heat-shock the mixture by incubation at 42°C for 30 sec.
Put the tube back on ice for 2 min.
Add 100 μL of SOC media to the mixture and incubate at 37°C for 30-60 min.
Pour 100 µl of the mixture into 15 mL of LB with kanamycin for pre-culture, and incubate with shaking at 37°C overnight.
Pour the 15 mL of pre-culture to 1 L of LB with kanamycin in a baffled flask.
Incubate at 37°C with shaking for 2-3 h until absorbance A600 becomes 0.6.
Shift the temperature to 18°C and incubate with shaking for 30 min.
Add 1 mL of 0.1 M IPTG (0.1 mM of final concentration) to induce protein expression and incubate at 18°C with shaking overnight.
Collect cells by centrifugation at 5,000 g for 20 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 40 mL of ice-cold Lysis10 buffer.
Add 800 μl of 10% Triton X-100 towards final concentration of 0.2% Triton X-100.
Sonicate the suspension to shear the DNA for 10 min on ice.
Centrifuge the suspension at 9,000 g for 10 min at 4°C to pellet cellular debris.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube on ice.
Repeat centrifuging and transferring steps to remove all debris.
Transfer 10 ml of a 50% slurry of Ni-NTA Agarose into a clean empty column.
Wash and equilibrate the column by running 20 ml of lysis buffer through it.
Add the supernatant from Step 7 lysate to the column.
Wash the column with 15 mL of Wash20 buffer.
Repeat washing the column with 15 mL of Wash20 buffer.
Elute the protein with 3 mL of Elute500 buffer.
Repeat eluting the protein with 3 mL of Elute500 buffer.
Analyze each fraction to determine purity of Cre protein by SDS-PAGE followed by CBB stain.
Purify the eluted HNCre protein with a gel filtration column and Buffer A using chromatography system and HiPrep 16/60 Sephacryl S-200 HR Gel Filtration Column.
Freeze the purified HNCre protein using liquid N₂ and store it at -80°C.
Thaw the frozen protein and dialyze it with HBS before use.
Maintain T87 cells with rotary shaker at 120 rpm under constant light at 22°C.
Passage T87 cells into fresh NT1 medium (pH 5.8) 1–5 days before electroporation.
Collect cells in a fresh 1.5 mL-tube.
Remove the supernatant and visually estimate the packed cell volume (pcv).
Wash cells once with Opti-MEM I (at least 1 volume of pcv).
Discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL of Opti-MEM I with 1–5 μM HNCre protein to the 20 µL pcv of cells on ice.
Transfer cells into a 4-mm-wide cuvette on ice.
Place the cuvette into NEPA21 TypeⅡ.
Use the electroporation program; 375 V/cm (150 V setting/0.4 cm width), 10 ms, 5 times, and a 50 ms interval for poring pulse, and 20 V, 50 ms, 20 times, and a 50 ms interval for transfer pulse.
Immediately after electroporation, add 800 µL of NT1 medium (pH 5.8) to the cuvette and transfer all cells to a new 1.5 mL-tube.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells with 1 mL of NT1 medium (pH 5.8).
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells with 2 mL of NT1 medium (pH 5.8).
Transfer cells to a 12-well plate.
Culture cells at 22°C with shaking until the assay.
Discard the supernatant two days after electroporation when using T87-xGxGUS cells.
Resuspend cells with 0.5 mg/mL of X-Glucuronide in staining buffer.
Incubate cells for 30 min at 37°C.
Transfer cells into 70% (w/v) ethanol.
Image cells using a phase contrast microscope.
Wash cells once with NT1 medium (pH 7.0).
Suspend cells with 5 µL of PCV in 100 µL of NT1 medium (pH 7.0).
Transfer cells to a black 96-well plate.
Add 5 µL of 200 µM CMUG to each well for fluorescence quantification.
Measure fluorescence using a microplate reader at excitation wavelength 355 nm and emission wavelength 460 nm.
Discard the supernatant two days after electroporation for genomic PCR.
Resuspend 10 µL pcv of cells with 10 µL of 250 mM NaOH and 0.1% Tween20.
Incubate cells for 10 min at 98°C to extract genomic DNA.
Add 5 µL of 1M Tris-HCl (pH 6.5).
Centrifuge cells at 10,000 g for 5 min at RT.
Collect the supernatant.
Perform genomic PCR using MightyAmp DNA Polymerase Ver.3 and the supernatant as a template DNA with primers TCCTTCGCAAGACCCTTCCTC and GGATGGCAAGAGCCAAATGCTTAG.
Analyze PCR products by agarose gel electrophoresis.
Stain gels with GelGreen.
Image gels using a transilluminator.
